title: What If Your Shadow Moved Three Seconds Before You?

clips.label: The impossible walk
clips.vo: What if your shadow moved three seconds before you did?
clips.visual: Wide night street. Mira walks into lamplight. Wall shadow turns first; Mira turns exactly three seconds later.

clips.label: Something is wrong
clips.vo: Mira stopped. Her shadow looked back. Three seconds later, so did she.
clips.visual: Medium two-shot against a mauve wall. Shadow looks back first. Mira follows, then recoils in surprise.

clips.label: One simple test
clips.vo: She raised one hand. The shadow had already done it.
clips.visual: Frontal wall test. Shadow raises hand at 0.55s; Mira at 3.55s. Three one-second clock beats make the lead visible.

clips.label: A warning, not a mistake
clips.vo: Then it ducked. Mira followed, just before the sign fell.
clips.visual: Wide alley. Shadow crouches at 0.55s; Mira at 3.55s. Suspended sign breaks at 4.05s and crashes beyond her.

clips.label: The close-up
clips.vo: It wasn't copying her. It was keeping her alive.
clips.visual: Face and upper-body close-up. Mira looks at the fallen sign, then toward the shadow. Fear softens into understanding.

clips.label: Listen to the warning
clips.vo: At her door, it pointed away. This time, Mira listened.
clips.visual: Oblique doorway composition. Shadow points away at 0.5s. Mira turns at 3.5s and starts walking back, away from the red door.

clips.label: The shadow stays
clips.vo: But when she walked away... whose shadow stayed behind?
clips.visual: Wide pull-back. Mira leaves left. Her shadow remains beside the shut door and waves on its own. Hold the unanswered question.
